additional_info.subject: ID0469445-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/S0 313971733003] Unsuccessful Charging Sessions on Outlet-2 CRM:03289000061
additional_info.body:
Dear
Yunus,
Following your request, and after our checks on all the charging sessions that failed we found that the issues are not all related.
Some sessions failed due to an MG1 problem, which means a fast-shutdown cable error. Other sessions failed due to cable-check issues between the EV and the charger, and another failure was related to an EV communication problem.
Since these errors are not related, we will continue to monitor the charger. If the error appears again, we will investigate further to identify the root cause and take the necessary actions to resolve the issue.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
